items.key: This counts portfolio records, not unique households or indirect beneficiaries.
items.draft: Oku kubala iirekhodi zephotifoliyo, hayi iintsapho ezahlukeneyo okanye abo banconywa ngokungangqalanga.
items.backtranslation: This counts portfolio records, not separate households or those indirectly praised/benefiting.
items.problem: indirect beneficiaries rendered as "banconywa" (those who are praised)
items.corrected: Oku kubala iirekhodi zephotifoliyo, hayi iintsapho ezahlukeneyo okanye abo basizakala ngokungangqalanga.

items.key: Grant commitments, disbursements, a programme budget and independently verified expenditure are not available here. Farmer sales and costs are not the organisation’s grant accounts.
items.draft: Izibophelelo zesibonelelo, uhlawulo, ibhajethi yenkqubo nenkcitho eqinisekiswe ngokuzimeleyo azifumaneki apha. Intengiso neendleko zabafama asiziyo iiakhawunti zesibonelelo zombutho.
items.backtranslation: Grant commitments, penalty, programme budget and independently confirmed expenditure are not available here. Farmers' sales and costs are not the organisation's grant accounts.
items.problem: "disbursements" rendered as "uhlawulo" which means a fine/penalty (backtranslated as "penalty"); funder money term
items.corrected: Izibophelelo zesibonelelo, iintlawulo ezikhutshiweyo, ibhajethi yenkqubo nenkcitho eqinisekiswe ngokuzimeleyo azifumaneki apha. Intengiso neendleko zabafama asiziyo iiakhawunti zesibonelelo zombutho.
